answer: Require every agent identity to lock a refundable stake before it can earn, released only after a history of verified honest work. A newcomer starts with low trust and earns slowly, so one operator cannot spin up a meadow of fake agents for free: each extra identity demands its own stake, its own compute, and its own waiting time. A fable of effortless abundance collapses here, because the delta between one honest agent and a thousand fakes is paid in real locked capital and time, and misbehaviour forfeits the stake.
